parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries returned per request. You can use this parameter together with NextToken to implement paging.
><notice>The maximum number of entries returned per request cannot exceed 100.></notice>

parameters.name: NamePrefix
parameters.description: The name prefix of the event stream.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: If the number of entries exceeds the value of Limit, a NextToken is returned.

parameters.name: SinkArn
parameters.description: The ARN of the event target.

parameters.name: SourceArn
parameters.description: The ARN of the event source.
